title: Dividends Explained
description: How to make money just by holding a stock.

slides.title: Sharing the Profits
slides.content: When a company makes a lot of profit, they can choose to give a portion of it directly to their shareholders. This cash payment is called a Dividend.

slides.title: Passive Income
slides.content: Dividends are usually paid quarterly (4 times a year). If a company pays a $1 dividend per share, and you own 100 shares, you get $100 in cash!

slides.title: Dividend Yield
slides.content: The Dividend Yield is a percentage showing how much a company pays out each year relative to its stock price. A 4% yield is considered strong.
